title: Modifier key doesn't work when pressing multiple keys at the same time
author: hwooo
summary: Simultaneous action-key presses under one modifier can leak literal letters instead of invoking remaps, but the proposed dedicated fix PR was closed unmerged and current behavior is unknown.

confidence.rationale: Live PR state and the missing current reproduction are unambiguous.

judgment.rationale: The bug was historically reproduced and recorded, yet the only PR explicitly closing it, 32125, was closed without merge. The latest request for a current 0.100.2+ retest has no answer.
evidence: Maintainers reproduced Alt plus two action keys causing literal input.
A 2023 commenter supplied a current-at-that-time settings screenshot and video.
PR 32125 explicitly targeted simultaneous shortcut invocation but is closed and unmerged.
Merged PR 31923 addresses AltGr state, not the general simultaneous-shortcut issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current deterministic key sequence and configuration before reviving the closed implementation approach.

fix_assessment.rationale: The direct fix attempt was not merged and current engine behavior has not been confirmed, so a new change cannot yet be scoped safely.

issue_context.summary: Simultaneous action-key presses under one modifier can leak literal letters instead of invoking remaps, but the proposed dedicated fix PR was closed unmerged and current behavior is unknown.
known_information: The issue is assigned and labeled Status-In progress despite no merged direct fix.
The original version was 0.33.1 and later reproduction was on 0.73.
The failure requires overlap between multiple action keys under one held modifier.
inferences: Engine behavior may have changed through later AltGr and shortcut-state work, so historical reproduction cannot establish current scope.
issue_context.analysis: A fresh bounded sequence can show whether the old state-machine defect persists and whether it is limited to Alt or applies to other modifiers.
initial_investigation: Read all ten comments, labels, assignee, and cross-references.
Inspected PRs 32125 and 31923 and distinguished the closed simultaneous-shortcut attempt from the merged AltGr fix.

actions.label: Confirm simultaneous shortcut leakage

comment.body:
Thanks for the historical settings, videos, and simultaneous-key clarification. PR #32125 attempted this fix but was closed without merge, so please provide a current reproduction before that approach is revived.

1. Retest on the current stable PowerToys release.
2. List the exact remaps and the numbered key-down/key-up sequence, including which two action keys overlap.
3. State whether literal characters are emitted and whether the same overlap fails with Ctrl or Win instead of Alt.

This will determine whether the current engine still has a general simultaneous-invocation defect or an Alt-specific state issue.
